"""Private IM1 builder: selectable GB6-v9 is mandatory in the image-browser OS candidate."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,argparse
R=Path('D:/S-760');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'scripts'))
from build_gb6_combo import patch_os_disk_bytes,patch_boot_rom_bytes,verify_disassembly,OS_SOURCE_SHA256,BOOT_SOURCE_SHA256

def build(out):
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 base=(R/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes();rom=(R/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN').read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest()==OS_SOURCE_SHA256 and hashlib.sha256(rom).hexdigest()==BOOT_SOURCE_SHA256
 browser_path=R/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-im1-ui-2026-10-19/browser-v8.img'
 browser=browser_path.read_bytes();gb6=patch_os_disk_bytes(base,'v9');boot=patch_boot_rom_bytes(rom)
 changes=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(base,browser)) if a!=b]
 assert len(browser)==len(base)
 assert all(gb6[i]==base[i] for i in changes),'Patch byte collision'
 os=bytearray(gb6)
 for i in changes:os[i]=browser[i]
 assert all(os[i]==gb6[i] for i in range(len(base)) if gb6[i]!=base[i])
 for name,data in [('combined.img',os),('gb6.bin',boot)]:
  with (out/name).open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
 report=dict(scope='private GB6-v9 plus browser-v8, not release; SDS/other repairs not linked',gb6_mandatory=True,controller_modes=[0,1,2,3],os_sha256=hashlib.sha256(os).hexdigest(),rom_sha256=hashlib.sha256(boot).hexdigest(),browser_sha256=hashlib.sha256(browser).hexdigest(),gb6_code_retained=True,overlap=0,disassembly=verify_disassembly(boot,os))
 (out/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report))
if __name__=='__main__':
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);build(parser.parse_args().out.resolve())

 body=body.replace('write_log(log)',"manager.machine.screens[':crt_screen']:snapshot("+json.dumps((work/'screen.png').as_posix())+"); write_log(log)") if False else body

 lua=work/'run.lua';lua.write_text('local RESULT_PATH='+json.dumps(out.as_posix())+'\n'+body)

 command=[str(R/'mame-source/mames760.exe'),'s760','-rompath',str(P/'roms')+';'+str(R/'roms'),'-video','none','-sound','none','-nothrottle','-skip_gameinfo','-nvram_directory',str(current_nvram),'-cfg_directory',str(work/'cfg'),'-snapshot_directory',str(work),'-autoboot_delay','0','-autoboot_script',str(lua),'-seconds_to_run',str(seconds)]
 run=subprocess.run(command,cwd=R/'mame-source',env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
 (work/'stdout.log').write_text(run.stdout);(work/'stderr.log').write_text(run.stderr)
 text=out.read_text() if out.exists() else '';assert run.returncode==0,(phase,run.returncode,run.stderr[-2000:]);assert all(x in text for x in expected),(phase,text)
 results.append(dict(phase=phase,passed=True,observed=text,expected=expected));print('PASS',phase,text.strip(),flush=True)

 (work/'note.pcm').write_bytes(pcm)
 click(118,4);wait(2);shot('reopened-collections.png');ram=(rt.observation_folder/'frame-08.ram').read_bytes();assert struct.unpack_from('<H',ram,0x5c10)[0]==0

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path('D:\\S-760')
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            kwargs['env']['S760_TOOLBOX_IMAGE_ROOT']=str((HERE/'sd').resolve())
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            # Lua may briefly hold the request file open on Windows.
            deadline=time.monotonic()+2
            while True:
                try:
                    temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt');break
                except PermissionError:
                    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise
                    time.sleep(.01)
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

 for b=0x100,0x10e,2 do x.selectors[string.format('%04x',b)]=bank(b) end

end)

 o=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.json','w'));o:write(json.stringify({cursor={r:read_u16(0xd0),r:read_u8(0xd2)},controller=p:read_u8(0x2476),bounds={p:read_u16(0x2138),p:read_u16(0x213a),p:read_u16(0x213c),p:read_u16(0x213e)},scale={p:read_u8(0x2140),p:read_u8(0x272e)},screen=r:read_u16(0xc2)}));o:close()
end)

local t=assert(io.open(folder..'/toolbox.jsonl','w'))
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x601e,0x601f,'ui-exchange-result',function(a,d,mask)
 if bank(0x10a)~=15 then return end
 local cdb=ram:read_block(0x5c28,10);local hex='';for i=1,#cdb do hex=hex..string.format('%02x',cdb:byte(i))end
